# usage audience

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:usageAudience`](gmeow-usageAudience.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/usageAudience>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The audience or scope in which the appellation is used — an [`Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md), a [`Group`](../classes/gmeow-Group.md)/Family, or a locale community. Range is [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) to admit all of them. Non-functional. ('Aunt Genny' is used toward the family; 欧德理 toward a Sinophone audience.)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record who a name is used TOWARD — the social scope of a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md), an agent, group/family, or locale community.

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating audience (who the name is used toward) with [`gmeow:usageAuthority`](gmeow-usageAuthority.md) / [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) (who ASSERTS the usage claim) — the social scope and the standpoint frame are orthogonal axes; use [`gmeow:usageRelationshipScope`](gmeow-usageRelationshipScope.md) when the scope is exactly one standing relationship.

### How to use

- Add one or more [`gmeow:usageAudience`](gmeow-usageAudience.md) entities to a [`NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) (non-functional); for a single tie, prefer [`gmeow:usageRelationshipScope`](gmeow-usageRelationshipScope.md), and keep the standpoint on [`gmeow:usageAuthority`](gmeow-usageAuthority.md) / [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md).
